summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Hotel Dynamic Pricing Simulator. 11/11 pytest backend tests pass (config, forecast, pace, optimize, simulate, recommend surge & fairness assertions, validation 422, explain + cache, runs create/list). Frontend Playwright E2E covers all critical flows: charts render, all 4 presets, warnings SURGE/PARITY, LLM explanation (source=gemini-3-flash confirmed), slider/season/event editing + Recommend, Accept (button shows 'Accepted'), Override with prompt dialog, Regenerate, Presenter Mode (step 1→2 titles verified, pause/resume label toggles, stop closes overlay), Reset restores defaults, StrategySheet + Export PDF elements present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_runs relies on d['_id'] then converts to str — fine, but consider projection to exclude _id from other endpoints (already done for explanations/warning_log).
runRecommend in App.js: if explain() fails it silently leaves explanation null (no toast). Minor UX.
PresenterMode auto-advance timer width uses hardcoded /20; keep in sync with STEP_SECONDS constant.
No pagination on /api/runs; fine for demo scale.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_run created via /api/runs during test_runs_create_and_list; benign for demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and covers all endpoints. Gemini 3 Flash working (source=gemini-3-flash, cached flag validated). All warning codes (SURGE, FAIRNESS, PARITY) triggered by respective presets as expected. Frontend data-testids all present and matching request spec.
